name: Claude-Red
description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
one_liner: A pack of expert 'cheat sheets' that turns an AI coding assistant into a knowledgeable helper for authorized security testing, covering everything from website hacking techniques to exploit writing.
buyer: A boutique penetration-testing or bug-bounty firm that wants its consultants to work faster on authorized client engagements by having an AI assistant pre-loaded with structured attack methodology.
business_use_cases: A penetration-testing consultancy standardizes its junior testers on these skills to speed up authorized client engagements and reports.
A cybersecurity bootcamp builds paid training modules and CTF practice around the skill library to teach students structured offensive methodology.
A bug-bounty hunter uses it as a personal productivity tool to systematically work through attack surfaces faster, increasing bounty throughput.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid, curated/maintained 'pro' version with updated techniques and vetted quality for security firms who don't want to manage it themselves.
Build a paid training course or certification program using the skill categories as its curriculum.

steal_this: Build a short paid workshop or cohort course that teaches one category (e.g. web app skills) using this library as the teaching material, clearly scoped to authorized/legal testing.
